```sh
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 "$WORK/2ecf-polar-c2-prefix-solve.py" \
  --scripts "$SCRIPTS" --prepared "$WORK/polar-c2-extended-prepared.json" \
  --state "$WORK/polar-c2-step08-step01-state.json" --prefix "$WORK/polar-c2-step09" --steps 1
```
